cap1.mp3: Sofia takes the 7:40 train every morning. She always sits in the same seat. On Monday there is a small brown notebook on it. There is no name on the front, and there is no phone number. The notebook is old, and it is nearly full. Sofia waits, but nobody comes back for it. The train is at her station, so she puts the notebook in her bag.
cap2.mp3: At work, Sofia opens the notebook. The first page is a short list: bread, milk, six eggs. Next to the eggs there is a small drawing of an egg. Six eggs is a lot of eggs for a list with three things on it. Under the list there is one more line, but Sofia cannot read it. The writing is very small and very fast.
cap3.mp3: On page four there is a drawing of a cat. It is a very bad drawing, but it is a cat. Under the cat there is one line. Sunday. He is still not eating. Sofia looks at her phone. Today is Monday. She closes the notebook, and then she opens it again.
cap4.mp3: Near the end there is an address, but the page is wet. The name of the street is gone. One thing is still black: the number 73. Sofia knows the three streets near the station. Only one of them has a number 73, because the other two stop at 40. She looks at the clock. Her train home is at 6:10. So she does not go to the station. She walks.
cap5.mp3: Number 73 is a small house with a red door. An old man opens it. Sofia gives him the notebook. He does not say thank you. He says: Page four? I write everything down, because I forget things. Then he takes her to the kitchen. The cat is asleep in a big box, next to the heater. He ate this morning, says the man. He only eats egg. On Sunday he was not eating, but I bought six. Why six? Because he is going to eat them. In the end Sofia misses the 6:10, and she is not sorry.
